name: plugin-phone-control
description: Track, answer, continue, and receive private alerts for Codex sessions from mobile.

interface.shortDescription: Follow local Codex work from your phone.
interface.longDescription: A local-first task dashboard for Codex Desktop and CLI sessions. Receive opt-in Web Push alerts, view minimized status, answer request_user_input, send sanitized images, create or permanently delete threads with safeguards, safely resume stored threads, steer verified active turns, and interrupt the exact active turn from a paired phone.
defaultPrompt: Show me how to start the Phone Control dashboard.
Check whether Phone Control can see this Codex session.
